findings.risk_interpretation: CLP harmonised EU classification: Acute Tox. 2 (H330), Acute Tox. 3 (H311), Acute Tox. 3 (H301), Skin Corr. 1B (H314), Eye Dam. 1 (H318), Skin Sens. 1A (H317). A hazard classification describes the pure substance; the risk for a consumer depends on its concentration in the product and on exposure, which the label does not give. The SCCS assessed its use in cosmetic products (SCCS/1557/15 Opinion on Methylisothiazolinone (MI) Submission III (sensitisation only)).
